hook: SoundExchange and Music Choice are locked in a seven-year legal battle over unpaid music royalties.

sections.voiceover: SoundExchange and Music Choice are locked in a seven-year legal battle over unpaid music royalties.
SoundExchange sued Music Choice in 2019 over alleged underpayments. Did auditor Prager Metis prove Music Choice concealed revenue from its Music Choice for Business service?
The U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit dismissed Music Choice's petition regarding royalty underpayments.
This legal battle resumed in November 2026, seven years after SoundExchange filed the original complaint.
Music Choice still faces these claims for underpaid royalties from the 2013 to 2016 period.
